what: booleans of a finely faceted body (a 1200-sided prism, 1202 flat faces, the kind of body a modelled thread leaves) with box tools: they must finish in bounded time with the exact result, not run for minutes
method: A regular N-gon of circumradius R (one vertex on +x) has area N/2 R^2 sin(2 pi/N). Plate: 1200-gon R=30, h=10: V0 = 600 * 900 * sin(0.3 deg) * 10 = 28274.2047. Cut: a 10x10 square pocket through the full thickness, entirely inside the plate: -10*10*10 = -1000. Join: a 12x12x5 box standing on the top face (z 10 to 15, x and y 8 to 20, inside the outline, touching the top face only in its base): +720. V = 27994.2047 mm3.
